classes.name: TNF inhibitors
classes.description: Adalimumab and biosimilars (Humira, Hadlima, Hyrimoz, Cyltezo, Yusimry, Simlandi, Amjevita, unbranded adalimumab-adaz/-fkjp/-aacf), etanercept (Enbrel, Erelzi, Eticovo), certolizumab (Cimzia), golimumab (Simponi). Infliximab is infusion/medical benefit.

classes.indication: RA, PsA, AS, psoriasis, Crohn's, UC

classes.name: IL-17 and IL-23 inhibitors

classes.name: Oral JAK inhibitors

classes.plainDescription: A daily pill for rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis or colitis.
